title: Reading the Registers of Honorius III without Manual Line Transcription: Forced-Aligned HTR, End to End, Modular or Hybrid
abstract: arXiv:2610.35085v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unlocking medieval archives at scale is bottlenecked by the cost of line-level diplomatic transcriptions and manual abbreviation expansion. Focusing on the registers of Pope Honorius III (1216-1227) over 5,000 letters surviving in full only as manuscript images - we show that existing, line-break-free expert transcriptions (edition drafts) suffice to train end-to-end hand-written text recognition (HTR) that jointly transcribes and expands heavily abbreviated Latin. Using forced alignment on 860 unaligned edition entries across 394 pages of Reg. Vat. 9, we automatically bootstrap 13,122 training lines without manual alignment of segmented lines. While the generic CATMuS baseline struggles on this domain (18.9% CER) and a modular space-free HTR + word-segmentation pipeline (cf. translated_title: 无需人工逐行转录读取霍诺留斯三世教皇登记册：强制对齐的手写文本识别——端到端、模块化或混合式方法
translated_abstract: 中世纪档案的大规模开发利用受限于逐行外交式转录与人工缩写展开的高昂成本。本文聚焦于教皇霍诺留斯三世（1216-1227年）的登记册——其中超过5,000封信件仅以手稿图像的形式完整保存——我们证明，现有的不含换行信息的专家转录文本（校勘本底稿）已足以训练端到端的手写文本识别（HTR）模型，实现高度缩写拉丁文的同步转录与缩写展开。通过对《Reg. Vat. 9》394页中的860条未经对齐的校勘本条目应用强制对齐技术，我们在无需人工对齐分行文本的情况下，自动构建了13,122条训练行。通用的CATMuS基线模型在该领域表现不佳（字符错误率CER为18.9%），模块化的无空格HTR加词切分流水线（参见Camps等人2021年工作）也止步于15.6%的词错误率（WER），而我们从零训练的混合Conformer模型——将CTC与双向子词注意力解码器及迭代自重对齐相结合——（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出利用强制对齐技术从无行对齐的校勘本底稿中自动生成训练数据，并采用结合CTC与双向子词注意力解码器的混合Conformer模型，实现了无需人工逐行转录即可对教皇霍诺留斯三世登记册中高度缩写的拉丁手稿进行端到端转录与缩写展开。
en_tdlr: This paper leverages forced alignment to automatically bootstrap training data from unaligned edition drafts and proposes a hybrid Conformer combining CTC with bidirectional subword attention decoders, enabling end-to-end transcription and abbreviation expansion of heavily abbreviated Latin manuscripts in the registers of Pope Honorius III without manual line transcription.
